title: Star Orbs
description: Replaces XP orbs with glowing stars that slowly spin and scatter upon spawn. Color and effects are configurable. Works on any server.
body:
Tired of the boring vanilla XP orbs? The Star Orbs mod redesigns the original experience orbs with glowing stars that fly outwards upon spawn, featuring optional particle effects and more. It is highly optimized with fully configurable settings. It works on any server as it is completely client-side.

## Example 1: 
![Stars (experience orbs) explode outwards from entity source](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23ee0a8a17aafd6e13a47d60746d87537dca2c74.gif)

## Example 2:
![Mob death orb spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ab3eab2b213563b385f9c1498943cf88e071d13.gif)

The stars spawn across a subtle range of scales, so they are not all the same size, adding a dynamic element to XP collection.

## AI Usage Disclaimer:
This mod was built with the assistance of AI tools.
